Ollama provider sends the chat to /api/chat and maps the native reply, including token counts and finish reason

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ extraBody: { num_ctx: 512, repeat_penalty: 1.1, top_k: 5 }, messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "ollama/qwen2:0.5b" });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
  console.log(result.model);
  console.log(result.usage?.promptTokens);
  console.log(result.usage?.completionTokens);
  console.log(result.usage?.totalTokens);
}

void main();
```
